Get Basketligaen Play-by-Play

Source: R/sportality.R
sportality_pbp.Rd

Play-by-play events with shot coordinates and the Genius ids (2023/24 on).

Endpoint: GET https://www.basketligaen.dk/api/gameday/play-by-play/{game_uuid}

Usage

sportality_pbp(game_uuid)

Arguments

game_uuid

(required) Game uuid: gameInfo[].uuid of the schedule (10 lowercase letters and digits). Key space: platform game uuids; the Genius match id is extId / gameSourceId in the body.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: Play-by-play events with shot coordinates and the Genius ids (2023/24 on). An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the documented columns come first, in this order (sdv-py sportality_pbp), then any column the API added later:

col_nametypedescription
game_source_idintegerGenius match id (Int64), the same number as game_id and sports-v2 game_info_ext_id.
game_idintegerGenius match id (Int64), the join to the genius family; on play-by-play lines, an integer elsewhere.
event_idintegerGenius event number within the game (Int64), increasing through the game.
typecharacterEvent type: one line per action; shots are the shooter's line, assists, blocks, steals and fouls drawn are further lines. Values: 2pt = two-point attempt (made when isSuccessful = 1); 3pt = three-point attempt (made when isSuccessful = 1); assist = assist on the previous made shot; block = block; clock = clock start, stop or adjustment; foul = foul committed; foulon = foul drawn (fouled player); freethrow = free-throw attempt; game = game start / end line; headcoachchallenge = head coach challenge; jumpball = jump ball or held ball; period = period start / end line; rebound = rebound; steal = steal; substitution = substitution (in or out); timeout = timeout; turnover = turnover.
event_uuidcharacterEvent uuid (UUID v5 derived from the event; unique per event).
periodintegerPeriod: 0 = the whole game, 1-4 the quarters, 5 and up overtime.
period_typecharacterREGULAR or OVERTIME; absent on the period marker lines. Values: OVERTIME = overtime period; REGULAR = regulation period.
timecharacterClock REMAINING in the period as mm:ss:cc (cc looks like hundredths of a second, only ever 00, 10, 30, 50 ... seen; unverified). Absent on the per-period marker lines.
real_world_timecharacterWall-clock time of the event, ISO 8601 UTC.
updated_timecharacterWhen the feed last updated the event, ISO 8601 UTC.
home_team_idintegerGenius team id of the home team (Genius key space; Int64).
home_team_codecharacterHome team code as Genius spells it (mixed case, 'Hol').
home_team_namecharacterName of the home team.
home_abbreviationcharacterHome team abbreviation.
home_team_numberintegerTeam number in the game; home is 1.
home_placecharacterSide of the home block: always home.
home_scoreintegerPoints scored by the home team.
away_team_idintegerGenius team id of the away team (Genius key space; Int64).
away_team_codecharacterAway team code as Genius spells it.
away_team_namecharacterName of the away team.
away_abbreviationcharacterAway team abbreviation.
away_team_numberintegerTeam number in the game; away is 2.
away_placecharacterSide of the away block: always away.
away_scoreintegerPoints scored by the away team.
revisionintegerRevision counter of the event.
game_statecharacterGame state at the event: ongoing during play, GameEnded on the final line. Values: GameEnded = game over (the final line of a complete feed); ongoing = game in progress.
game_typecharacterGame type of the game (” on every line seen).
roundintegerRound number (0).
start_date_and_timecharacterStart of the game (” on every line seen).
sub_typecharacterRefinement of type (the shot type, rebound kind, foul kind, ...); null on types that have none. Values: 1of1 = free throw 1 of 1; 1of2 = free throw 1 of 2; 1of3 = free throw 1 of 3; 24sec = shot-clock violation; 2of2 = free throw 2 of 2; 2of3 = free throw 2 of 3; 3of3 = free throw 3 of 3; 3sec = three-second violation; 5sec = five-second violation; 8sec = eight-second violation; adjustment = clock adjustment; alleyoop = alley-oop shot; alleyoopdunk = alley-oop dunk; backcourt = backcourt violation; badpass = bad pass; ballhandling = ball-handling error; benchTechnical = technical foul on the bench; coachTechnical = technical foul on the coach; defensive = defensive rebound; disqualifying = disqualifying foul; disruptive = disruptive foul (unverified); doubledribble = double dribble; drivinglayup = driving layup; dunk = dunk; end = end of the period or game; eurostep = euro-step layup; fadeaway = fadeaway jump shot; flagrant = flagrant foul; floatingjumpshot = floating jump shot; full = full timeout; heldball = held ball; hookshot = hook shot; in = player enters; jumpshot = jump shot; layup = layup; lodgedball = lodged ball; lost = lost the jump ball; offensive = offensive rebound or offensive foul; offensivegoaltending = offensive goaltending; officials = official timeout; other = other; out = player leaves; outofbounds = out of bounds; outofboundsrebound = rebound off an out-of-bounds ball (unverified); personal = personal foul; pullupjumpshot = pull-up jump shot; reverselayup = reverse layup; start = start of the period or game, or clock start; startperiod = start of a period (jump ball line); stepbackjumpshot = step-back jump shot; stop = clock stop; technical = technical foul; throwIn = throw-in violation (unverified); tipindunk = tip-in dunk; tipinlayup = tip-in layup; travel = traveling; turnaroundjumpshot = turnaround jump shot; unsportsmanlike = unsportsmanlike foul; won = won the jump ball.
qualifierscharacterEvent qualifiers joined by ';' (a list in recent games, a ';'-joined string or null in older ones).
is_successfulinteger1 when the action succeeded (a made shot or free throw, a recorded rebound ...). ABSENT, not 0, for a missed shot, so count misses as rows without it.
instance_idcharacterSite instance id of the club or league (platform key space, <code><n>_<code> such as hol2_hol; the league itself is dbl1_dbl).
sourcecharacterFeed that produced the line (genius-basketball-stream-reader).
game_uuidcharacterPlatform game uuid (c4hh5nig6t); every gameday route takes it.
event_team_idintegerGenius team id (Genius key space; Int64).
event_team_codecharacterTeam code as Genius spells it.
event_team_namecharacterName of the team.
event_abbreviationcharacterTeam abbreviation.
event_team_numberintegerTeam number in the game (1 home, 2 away).
event_placecharacterSide of the team the event belongs to: home or away.
player_idintegerGenius person id (Int64). A string key in the players maps, an integer in play-by-play and box-score rows; cast here so the frames join, and join the genius family.
player_pnointegerGenius shirt-table number of the player.
player_team_numberintegerTeam number in the game (1 home, 2 away).
player_first_namecharacterGiven (first) name(s) of the player.
player_family_namecharacterFamily name (this route says familyName; the others lastName).
coordinates_xdoubleShot or event x coordinate in Genius court units (Float64); origin and scale unverified.
coordinates_ydoubleShot or event y coordinate in Genius court units (Float64); origin and orientation unverified.
period_timeintegerMarker lines only: 0 (an integer), the start of the period.

Details

  • Unofficial: the JSON API behind www.basketligaen.dk, the Danish men's basketball league (Basketligaen, series code DBL). The site runs on the Sportality platform (the vendor behind the SHL and HockeyAllsvenskan wrappers). The terms page was not read; payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Stats provider: genius-basketball, a relay of Genius Sports LiveStats. The Genius match, team and person ids in play-by-play, box scores and stats tables (game_id, team_id, player_id, all Int64) join the genius family; the platform uuids (game, team, athlete, ssgt) are not Genius ids and exist only on this site. The Genius ORG code of Denmark is not exposed.

  • Season = the END year (2026 = 2025/26) everywhere; the runtime maps it, with game_type ('regular' or 'finals', the playoffs), to the site's ssgt (season + series + game type) through layout-info. Schedules, standings and season tables start in 2002/03; game-level data (play-by-play with shot x/y, box scores, team stats) starts in 2023/24.

  • Source defects the runtime refuses (hoopR_asset_fetch): an unfinished game or a truncated play-by-play feed, a box score or feed that names another game, a cut stats table. The 2002/03 regular-season schedule lists 109 finished games where its own standings count 110: a source gap.

  • Personal data is removed from every body: birth dates, e-mail addresses, phone numbers, addresses and contact blocks.

  • No women's league: Dameligaen has its own domain (dameligaen.dk), which answers 401 to anonymous requests.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (404, an empty gameday body, {} / [], a table with no rows, a season or game type layout-info does not list), hoopR_bad_request (a bad argument, a 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (an error envelope or non-JSON 200, a body for another game / team / athlete / ssgt, an unfinished game or truncated play-by-play, a cut stats table, any other non-2xx; a 500 is the site's answer for an unknown uuid and is not retried), all inheriting hoopR_error. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame.
